staff_draft:
Dear applicant,

Thank you for your interest in the Master's programme in Project Management and Data Science at HTW Berlin.

I am happy to answer your questions:

Application deadline: The application period for the summer semester 2027 intake is from 1 May to 31 August 2026. [Doc 1]

Language of instruction: The programme is taught entirely in English. [Doc 2]

Study format: This is a two-year, on-campus programme. [Doc 2]

Required documents: You need to submit the following documents attached to the online application form: a copy of your degree certificate, a copy of your grade transcript, and proof of English language proficiency. If you are an applicant from China, Vietnam, or India, you must also submit a certificate from the academic test centre (APS). If your grade transcript is in another language, please also provide a translation in either English or German. [Doc 1] [Doc 3]

To apply, please fill out the online application form on the programme website. If you have any further questions, you can contact the admissions team directly at Admission-MPMD@HTW-Berlin.de.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services
